# Three.js r160

`three-r160.module.min.js` is an unmodified copy of the official Three.js r160 build:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r160/build/three.module.min.js

- Bytes: 670681
- Git blob: `9807b610d02fd0a1833fa7ceae44239652c78f3c`
- SHA-256: `3e690ac7d180b0aadf0891bea39eec643e29e2d3e75c99b18689518665f69ba6`
- License: MIT; see `three-LICENSE.txt` (official r160 LICENSE).

The sandbox resolves the scaffold's pinned CDN import to this first-party asset
at runtime. Original generated HTML is retained unchanged for repairs and export.
No user content is added to this directory.
